description: This file contains utility functions related to handling npm package resolution and installation records, including pinning specifications, mapping resolution metadata, building installation record fields, and logging associated messages.

methods.name: export function resolvePinnedNpmSpec(params: { resolvePinnedNpmSpec
methods.description: Resolves the pinned npm specification, returning the record specification and optional warning/notice messages based on whether the spec is pinned and resolved.

methods.name: export function mapNpmResolutionMetadata(resolution?: NpmResolutionMetadata): { mapNpmResolutionMetadata
methods.description: Maps npm resolution metadata to a simplified object with relevant fields like name, version, and resolution details.

methods.name: export function buildNpmInstallRecordFields(params: { buildNpmInstallRecordFields
methods.description: Builds an installation record object for an npm package, including source, spec, install path, and resolution details.

methods.name: export function resolvePinnedNpmInstallRecord(params: { resolvePinnedNpmInstallRecord
methods.description: Creates an npm install record considering pinning options, resolution data, and logs messages accordingly.

methods.name: export function resolvePinnedNpmInstallRecordForCli( resolvePinnedNpmInstallRecordForCli
methods.description: A CLI-specific wrapper for resolving npm install records, integrating logging and warning message formatting.

methods.name: export function logPinnedNpmSpecMessages( logPinnedNpmSpecMessages
methods.description: Logs warning and notice messages related to pinned npm specs.
